summary: Human remains believed to be Chicago hiker James Nelson, missing since Oct 2010, recovered near Holy Cross City; a camper scouting sites found the campsite May 25 and VMRG + sheriff's detectives hiked in the next day, remains turned over to the coroner for identification
location: Holy Cross City / Mount of the Holy Cross
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Recovery op for the missing-hiker case in id 104 (2010-10-03): campsite with a notebook suggesting altitude sickness found Fri May 25, 2012; camera, GPS and camp stove missing; cadaver-dog follow-up searches planned with VMRG
